retractionUm.note: Approximately; ON/OFF at top endpoint only. Lower turn retracts; upper turn restores plus selected feed.

orientationDegrees.note: Selected UCC; restrictions for larger optional clamps are not inherited.

lateralBladePositions.note: Three predefined stop positions may be used if desired (p54); not three exclusive permissible positions.

holderScaleMarksDegrees.note: Scale markings are not proof of hard mechanical stops.

trimFeedRule.value: max(sectionThicknessUm, trimLeverUm) when lever held at 10 or 30; sectionThicknessUm otherwise
trimFeedRule.note: Trimming is not additive. A selected section thickness greater than the trim setting dominates.

mechanism.rotation: Clockwise handwheel viewed from its right side in normal full-turn sectioning. Exact angular linkage is not published; any sinusoidal carriage rendering is explicitly schematic.
causalSequence: cassette clamped; blade seated and clamped; base and orientation locked
guard lowered and handwheel released for cutting
descending block intersects blade: material removed once per contact pass
lower turn: retract ~40 µm when enabled
return stroke: no additional section generated
upper turn: restore retraction offset and advance one selected feed
continue same block and accumulate ordered sections
top lock and guard before sample change or interruption
mechanism.rockingMode: Supported by the real instrument. Trim with retraction OFF recommended p32. Rocking feed engagement phase is not yet sufficiently specified; core operation remains required and unimplemented, not silently excluded. S1 p43 also warns against counterclockwise handwheel rotation. Scope reconciliation remains unresolved; no invented rocking implementation.

manualSectioningSpeedRpm.note: Harder specimens require slower cutting. This ceiling is not a guarantee of section quality.

science.representation: uncalibrated educational sectioning model, not a predictor of diagnostic section quality
rules: A section requires material intersecting an exposed blade on the cutting stroke, not merely one handwheel revolution.
A section is a new slice of the same block ID and depth; material cannot be duplicated or regenerated by changing view.
Nominal feed is not measured final section thickness: compression, chatter, tearing, dull edge, clamping, temperature and orientation affect result.
Retraction protects the block face and blade on return; it is not additional permanent feed.
Paraffin ribbon formation is conditional and may be interrupted; do not guarantee continuous ribbons.
Do not conflate knife clearance angle with specimen orientation or blade bevel angle.
No physiological, stain, molecular or diagnostic result is inferred from a synthetic unstained section.
